criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Directly named OSM way 860901797 carries the church name, place-of-worship/Lutheran tags, 300 Fowler Ave address, and official website; the church homepage independently states 300 W Fowler Ave and links map directions whose resolved pin (40.4278394, -86.9084334) is inside the polygon. Reopened mesh represents all 9 source ring vertices within 0.00001484 m.
criteria.limitations: OSM is community maintained and is not a survey; the nearby Purdue ArcGIS FID 823 is a different building (Fairway, COOP, 1320 David Ross Rd) and is excluded.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The source polygon's transformed campus bounds are [[426.63126319444285, 453.9317966755379], [33.38972800043621, 62.737600000189104]]; the saved structural base bounds match those source bounds, and object transform is identity. Official map pin is contained in the footprint. The exact crosswalk rejection avoids substituting the nearby GIS feature.
criteria.limitations: Horizontal accuracy is unpublished; campus projection is approximate and no survey/dimensioned plan is available.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Church exterior photographs directly support the steep/asymmetric gabled sanctuary roof and raised sail-like gable. The modeled roof silhouette uses these photographed features.
criteria.limitations: No measured height, story count, roof schedule, or calibrated photo is provided. All reported heights (eaves 4.8 m, ridge 14.2 m, gable 16.0 m, cross 18.1 m) and roof pitch are estimates; the reopen bounds top at 18.10 m.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The church’s own exterior photographs show the warm brick base, teal vertical cladding, large triangular stained-glass gable, steep dark roof, cross, and glazed entrance. The saved render/model includes these principal visual elements.
criteria.limitations: The photo is perspective and unscaled; exact door offset, side-window placement, color values, glass segmentation, and all feature dimensions remain illustrative.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Independent cold reopen passed expected manifest path/collection, one mesh, identity transform, no modifiers, no linked libraries, and no external image files. The building folder includes raw OSM and official church source snapshots, the rejected GIS candidate, preview, source metrics, and reopen results. Checks: {"identity transform": true, "manifest path and collection match": true, "no linked libraries or file-backed images": true, "no modifiers": true, "one named mesh in expected collection": true, "saved .blend loaded": true}
criteria.limitations: No packaging or export defects found.

findings: PASS at 8.75/10; the named OSM footprint and official church identity are independently corroborated, and the false ArcGIS FID 823 crosswalk is correctly rejected.
